trigger.sampling_unit_leakage: The initial ladder audit found 67 action trajectories whose steps visited domains in different hash partitions.
trigger.source_capacity: After whole-trajectory exclusion, the training pools contain 55,697 action, 518,640 QA, and 15,352 grounding examples. The grounding pool is intrinsically concentrated in a small set of domains.

changes.sampling_unit_policy: Assign complete sampling units only when every included domain hashes to the same partition; otherwise exclude the complete unit.

rationale: The fixed proportions preserve a clean training-size ablation while maximizing browser actions within the leakage-safe pool. Task-specific caps state the actual source limitations explicitly and retain every website family at every tier. No EXP005 model inference or training had begun when this amendment was made.
